entries.title: Firstmate finds your GitHub repository by name
entries.body: Firstmate now searches all of your GitHub repositories, not only the 50 most recently changed. It also takes a name written loosely, such as meter lab, or a pasted address. When it cannot find one, a crewmate searches GitHub for it before you are asked for a link.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: Firstmate finds the repository in conversation.
